claims.text: The NCEL approach consistently outperforms various baselines with favorable generalization ability in evaluations on five public benchmarks.
The efficiency of NCEL is verified through theoretical comparisons of its time complexity with other collective alternatives.
NCEL utilizes structured graph information effectively, improving performance on challenging datasets.
